subject: Runtime binding governance sprint: LangChain & LlamaIndex SDK readiness
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@promptforge.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: 2-week governance sprint to certify PromptForge SDK binding

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Following our booth conversation, PromptForge would like to propose a short governance sprint to certify our SDK bindings against Redwood's runtime (LangChain / LlamaIndex usage patterns + tracing). The goal: create a lightweight certification checklist and CI harness that validates correct KV cache handling, tracing hooks, and model variant fallback semantics.

Attachments: pf-sdk-spec-v1.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf (high-level artifacts).

High-level ask:
- 2-week joint sprint (1-2 engineers from each side)
- Tech sync to agree acceptance criteria and test harness (60m)
- Access to a Redwood dev runtime instance and a sample model variant for tests

Proposed time: Tue 2027-06-22 10:00 PT (we're flexible)

Samir
Partner Engineering
PromptForge AI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@promptforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 2-week governance sprint to certify PromptForge SDK binding

Samir — thanks for the note and the artifacts. This aligns well with some of our ISV enablement goals for H2.

Quick responses / asks from our side:
- We agree to a sprint model, but we prefer outcome-driven gates: checklist + CI that runs against our curated "compat" model.
- Karthik, can you draft the tech acceptance criteria (tracing, kv cache consistency, serialization/quantization behaviours) and a minimal test matrix?
- Vanessa — can you own commercial/compliance gating (whitelist for dedicated infra + SOC2 artifact review)?
- Samir — please share a small sample repo (branch) and an API key with dev-only scopes so our automation can run against your SDK repo.
- Let's confirm Tue 2027-06-22 10:00 PT for the tech sync. I'll send a calendar invite after we confirm.

Action items:
1) Karthik: draft acceptance criteria by EOD Mon (2027-06-21).
2) PromptForge: sample repo + dev API key by Mon EOD.
3) Vanessa: list contract/compliance redlines to review during sprint.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Aditya Rao
Director, Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@promptforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 2-week governance sprint to certify PromptForge SDK binding

Aditya / Samir — putting a first-pass acceptance checklist below. I'll convert to a markdown checklist and push to our shared space.

Technical acceptance (initial):
- Tracing: SDK must emit OpenTelemetry-compatible spans for request start/end, model variant selection, and fallback events. Sampling config must be overridable via env/config.
- KV cache correctness: When using continuous batching, KV cache must be stable across repeated partial prompts (no cache leakage across sessions).
- Tokenization parity: Outputs must be deterministic within a model variant for the same prompt and seed. Document any non-determinism.
- Long-context behavior: For sequence lengths > 8k, SDK should implement prefix slicing consistent with Redwood runtime windowing.
- Failure modes: graceful fallback to a compatible model variant without panics; return standardized error codes we can map in our tracing/metrics.
- CI smoke: provide a GH Actions workflow that runs minimal end-to-end flow against our dev runtime and posts results as an artifact.

I'll attach a checklist file (redwood-trace-checklist.md) with tests, expected logs, and example span names.

One technical ask: can PromptForge expose a "replay" endpoint or lightweight test harness so our CI can replay a set of request traces deterministically? That would massively speed up validation.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime Instrumentation
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-trace-checklist.md (stub)

- Sharing a dev API key via secure channel (Sent to Aditya via 1Password).
- Contract draft attached for commercial/legal review (contract-draft-pf-redwood.pdf). We can route this through DocuSign after legal thumbs-up.

We can run a short demo of the replay harness in the Tue 10:00 PT sync. We're OK with the acceptance checklist Karthik proposed — we'll iterate.

Samir
